title: Winter Practice Period Shuso's Class - Continuing Our Maturity Part 4
speaker: Shin-yu Scott Allen
summary: Through mindfulness and meditation, we can develop greater awareness of our patterns of pain and suffering, and by letting go of them, we can cultivate a sense of ease, freedom, and acceptance in life. This process allows us to regain control over our lives and live with respect and forgiveness, rather than being controlled by our thoughts and emotions. By embracing this path, we can find direction and meaning in life through making long-term commitments or vows, which bring joy and purpose, even if the goal is not fully attained.
